name: Data Access Security Data Owner Identified
description: Sent to each user chosen as an owner when a data owner election finishes for a resource, for elections configured to assign owners automatically and to send invitations.
subject: You have been identified as a data owner
body:
You have been identified as a data owner

Hello $__recipient.name,

As part of an election to identify data owners for sensitive data assets, your peers have selected you as the data owner for the resource below.

Application: $assignment.appName

Resource: $assignment.resourcePath

As a data owner, you will take a more active role in protecting sensitive information and governing the data assets you own. You may be asked to initiate or participate in governance processes such as reviewing inappropriate access and suspicious activity, reviewing and certifying currently assigned access, or approving new access requests.

Thank you in advance for helping ensure secure access to critical information.

This automated message was sent by Data Access Security. Please do not reply.
